months.label: February 2027
months.title: Sharing is harder than it looks
months.event: Countries want to reuse each other’s tests. But secrets, and each country making its own choice, make that harder than sharing one score.

months.label: March 2027
months.title: A practice is not the real thing
months.event: Your partners want to announce good news. Be clear about the difference between a practice that was started and a safety fix that was tested again.

months.label: April 2027
months.title: The missing page
months.event: People argue about one result. It shows that a report is not proof unless someone else can repeat it. Follow-up meetings can turn a mistake into a stronger deal.

months.title: What can still be finished?
months.event: One month until Geneva. New tests may not come back in time. Choose which unfinished work gets your last meetings.

months.event: Geneva, 21 June. Use your last three meetings. Then choose what the final agreement can honestly say.

routes.lesson: A service's consequences depend on how its output is used. A review that stops at the visible interface can miss the decision influenced by its recommendation.
routes.repair: Extend the review to the work process that uses the recommendation and identify its approving owner. Check the applicable requirements for that full use before rehearsing the agency's decision.

check.question: Why should the review follow the recommendation beyond the interface?
answers: A simple-looking interface guarantees a low-impact service.
Another process may use the answer to make a consequential decision.
check.explanation: The interface shows only part of the service. Following its output reveals the decision the review needs to examine.

routes.researchContext: Whether a legal review is required depends on the particular use and applicable rules. The legal provisions and transition dates in this dossier were inherited from earlier research, not newly verified; a voluntary test is the fallback if a duty is not established.

plans.pilot: Ask for a record tracing one service's recommendation into the decision it influences. Record the approving owner and any uncertainty about the requirements for that use.
plans.shared: Ask for a common review record linking services to their consequential decisions. Each agency still needs to approve its use, verify its own decision links and applicable requirements, and make its own acceptance decision.

research.headline: The legal route remains plausible, but the kiosk candidate may be assistance rather than a qualifying decisional system
research.nextTest: First trace one AI output into an actual administrative decision and establish the statutory scope and signatory. If it is only assistance, honestly run a voluntary service-owner quality/safety test instead of claiming a statutory AI02 gate. Falsifier for the statutory route: no qualifying decision link, no applicable assessment duty, or no authorised restriction.
